name: What is the typical timeline for a tiny home project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a tiny home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a tiny home project can vary significantly based on factors like design complexity, permitting processes, material availability, and construction method (DIY vs. professional build). Generally, it can take anywhere from 3 months to over a year. Initial planning, design, and permitting often require several weeks or months. Construction itself for a professional build might take 8-16 weeks. Customization and site preparation can also extend the duration. We work closely with clients to establish a realistic timeline for their specific project from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiny home project timelines vary, typically ranging from 3 months to over a year, depending on design complexity, permitting, and construction method.
